topics.title: How to prepare a useful website project brief
topics.brief: A practical guide for small businesses: goals, audiences, page requirements, content, integrations, access, budget and acceptance criteria. Include a reusable brief checklist. No invented prices or client stories.

topics.title: A website handover checklist for business owners
topics.brief: Explain repository ownership, domain and hosting access, documentation, backups, licences and optional maintenance. Use the Cholbei ownership model.

topics.title: Websites for service businesses
topics.brief: Explain enquiries, clear service information, accessible contact paths and client-owned delivery. Explain how to discuss scope with Cholbei. Do not invent guarantees or testimonials.

topics.title: Plan your website content before development starts
topics.brief: Practical preparation of service descriptions, images, navigation and calls to action. Give original illustrative examples clearly marked as examples.

topics.title: Questions to ask before hiring a website developer
topics.brief: Help a buyer discuss source code, account ownership, recurring costs, licences, change requests, testing and handover.

topics.title: Business websites built around better enquiries
topics.brief: Describe forms, email contact, scope-dependent lead workflows and reporting without promising conversion results. Explain the Basic and Business pack starting points.
